items.reason: A gentle, fragrance-free-style cleanse that won't strip dry, sensitive-looking skin.
A ceramide moisturizer to support a comfortable skin barrier and add moisture.
A mineral SPF 50 for daily protection, since fair skin can look redder after sun exposure.

response.routine_note: We removed the vitamin C serum and glycolic toner because strong acids can sting and make dry, sensitive skin look redder, so a gentle cleanser, moisturizer and mineral sunscreen is a calmer start. Because you say your face is always red, a dermatologist is the right person to look at it, and we would rather not sell more actives in the meantime.
